description: Land Acquisition - Compensation for the Land Acquired Medadumbara D/S Division. Kandy District (Section 33)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains notices for the acquisition of specific land parcels (Galapitawatta and Aguruwala Kele) for the Knuckles Reserve, including details about land extent, compensation amounts, and court case references. The content focuses entirely on land/property matters without any government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or other specialized categories, making it a clear Land Gazette (Type 4).
